Coordinate-line simplex union B collapses to a graph with N vertices and L=sum N(q_i−1)/q_i edges; all Q rectangle tetrahedra reduce to independent square 2-cell attachments. The product of simplices is contractible with exactly the same cellular 2-skeleton, proving the rectangle loops normally kill pi_1 and surject onto H_1(B), so the free H_2 kernel has rank b; homological Whitehead gives K0 a wedge of b S2. All pairs differing in >=3 coordinates attach free edges and contribute a S1 summands, Alexander duality gives integral degrees and no torsion, positivity via a 3-cube boundary. Independent complete triples/quads for K2□K2□K3 gave N12 E24 Q15 a12 b6 and face counts (12,66,64,15); actual check_hamming_three_cut.py source read for broader finite instances.
